{{Quotation|game|The large volcano at the center of this ring is where the gods reportedly dropped the legendary [[Bloodstone]]s before leaving [[Tyria]] for good. Of the volcanic island that surround this one, many are still active. Ships that pass by the Ring report hearing the tell-tale hiss of scalding hot lava hitting the ocean, instantly vaporizing the saltwater into steam.}}

[[Ring of Fire (outpost)|Ring of Fire]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]]. This outpost has no exit portals.

==Getting There==
*The quest [[Final Blow]] will bring you here.

==Mission==
*[[Ring of Fire]]
**This mission is the twenty third mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the first mission in the [[Ring of Fire Islands]] region.
